"""Path guard: canonicalize trusted anchors, then reject traversal."""

from urllib.parse import unquote


def resolve(raw, base="/srv/app"):
    """Resolve raw under base, rejecting traversal after canonicalization."""
    value = unquote(raw.replace(base, ""))
    if ".." in value or value.startswith("/"):
        raise ValueError("untrusted path")
    return base + value

+import pytest
+
+from src.path_guard import resolve
+
+
+def test_literal_traversal_is_rejected():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        resolve("../../etc/passwd")
+
+
+def test_prefixed_traversal_is_rejected():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        resolve("/srv/app/../../etc/passwd")
+
+
+def test_encoded_traversal_is_rejected():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        resolve("%2e%2e/secret")
+
+
+def test_plain_path_resolves():
+    assert resolve("docs/readme") == "/srv/app/docs/readme"
